author: Slidebean
description:
Gamers might fix air traffic

The FAA is recruiting video gamers.

Why?
Air traffic control is a mental overload job.

Tracking dozens of planes.
Making split second decisions.

The real problem isn’t talent.
It’s outdated infrastructure.

The limit isn’t the sky
it’s how many humans can keep up.

title: The FAA needs gamers

author: Slidebean
description:
Data centers are going to space

40 Nvidia GPUs are now orbiting Earth.

Not for storage 
for processing data in space.

No cooling.
No delay sending data to Earth.

If it works,
AI might move above the cloud.
